methods.name: Quest skip to level 34
methods.note: Witch's Potion and Imp Catcher give level 10. The Grand Tree and Watchtower reach 33, and any other quest with a Magic reward passes 34. Fights can be safespotted.

methods.name: Splashing
methods.note: Autocast at -64 Magic attack on a weak monster, a click every 20 minutes. 1,200 casts an hour of your best spell. Strikes cost about 1 gp an XP, waves and surges 8 to 10.

methods.name: Arceuus Library books
methods.note: Each book handed in gives 15 times your Magic level. 120 books an hour with the Kourend Library plugin, 150 with stamina. No runes needed.

methods.name: Enchanting bolts
methods.note: One click enchants 10 sets, one every 3 ticks: about 2,000 casts an hour alongside other things. Stops at diamond: too few dragonstone or onyx bolts are sold. A loss.

methods.name: Enchanting bolts (1-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect. Hold space and click the spell every tick, about 5,500 casts an hour. The GE sells 11,000 bolts of a type per 4 hours, so stock up first. Very expensive.

methods.name: Enchanting jewellery
methods.note: Lvl-1 to Lvl-5 Enchant cast by hand on GE jewellery, about 1,600 an hour with banking. Left to autocast it is about half. Usually a small profit. Lvl-5 ties up millions.

methods.name: Mage Training Arena
methods.note: Casual pace in the best room: Enchanting Chamber, the Alchemist's Playground from 21 (about 900 nature runes an hour), Lvl-6 enchanting at 87. Points buy wands and runes.

methods.name: Rock crabs with combat spells
methods.note: Rellekka. Aggressive for 10 minutes, then walk off to reset. Earth spells hit 20% harder there. No requirements. Rate estimated from your best spell: the wiki gives none.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab with combat spells
methods.note: It burrows about every 10 minutes: crawl through the cave and attack again. No weakness and 87.5% XP, so the wiki rates other crabs higher for Magic. Rate estimated.

methods.name: Frost crabs with fire spells
methods.note: Ruins of Tapoyauik in Varlamore. A 100% fire weakness doubles fire spell damage. Reset aggression every 10 minutes. Rate estimated: the wiki gives none.

methods.name: Low Level Alchemy
methods.note: 31 XP a cast every 3 ticks, 60k an hour at most standing still and much less alongside other training. Usually a small loss. Switch to High Level Alchemy at 55.

methods.name: Superheat Item
methods.note: 53 XP a cast plus Smithing XP. Ironmen superheat their own iron or gold ore and the guide warns it eats nature runes. Only listed for 43 to 55.

methods.name: High Level Alchemy
methods.note: 65 XP a cast, 78k an hour at most standing still. Expect 20k to 50k when alching alongside other training. Ironmen alch Slayer drops and crafted items.

methods.name: Blood bursting desert bandits
methods.note: Big Heist Lodge in the Bandit Camp with a Saradomin or Zamorak item and a staff that autocasts Ancient Magicks. Blood spells heal you. Barrage at 92. Runes are a loss.

methods.name: Bursting maniacal monkeys
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon: Monkey Madness II started is enough. Bring a light source and a staff that autocasts Ancient Magicks. Auto retaliate, Protect from Melee. Barrage at 94.

methods.name: Burst or barrage Slayer tasks
methods.note: Warped jellies (52 Slayer), dust devils (65), nechryaels (80) and smoke devils (93) on task. Drops usually cover the runes. No Magic rate on the wiki, so none is shown.

methods.name: Cure Me on araxytes
methods.note: Tick-perfect. Cast Cure Me every tick while araxytes in the Morytania Spider Cave keep you venomed. Up to 414k at 6,000 casts an hour. Needs prayer potions.

methods.name: Tan Leather
methods.note: 81 XP a cast tans five hides, about 8,000 hides an hour with good timing and quick banking. Buy dragonhide and sell the leather at a profit. Use a fire staff.

methods.name: String Jewellery
methods.note: 83 XP an amulet and one click strings a whole inventory in 49 seconds. About 1,500 an hour half watching, 160k flat out. Diamond amulets (u) lose about 150 gp each.

methods.name: Plank Make
methods.note: Autocast on mahogany logs, about 90 seconds an inventory. Manual casting gives 166k. Small profit for mains. Ironmen need their own logs.

methods.name: Barraging Wilderness bandits
methods.note: Lava bridge by the Bandit Camp in level 19 Wilderness, so risk little. Ice Barrage on auto retaliate from a staff that autocasts it. Ice sacks replace runes. Profitable.

unverified: Enchanting bolts (both entries): the Grand Exchange sells 11,000 bolts of one type per 4 hours, which is 1,100 casts, so neither rate can be kept up for long without stockpiling; the format has no field for a supply cap; dragonstone bolts (68) and onyx bolts (87) give more a cast but trade in the tens of thousands a day against the 1.37 million a 68 to 99 would use, so both entries stop at diamond

Enchanting bolts (1-tick): the guide's table works sapphire at 17 XP and pearl at 29 where the spell pages say 17.5 and 29.5, so those two bands are up to 3% low; topaz at 29 (181,500) is slower than emerald at 27 and left out, jade at 14 has no Grand Exchange price
Arceuus Library books: 120 books an hour is the guides' only figure and no second source confirms it; the jump-down shortcuts added on 12 August 2026 (52 and 62 Agility) are newer than that figure

Mage Training Arena: the level 7 band applies the overview's casual pace (130,000 an hour with Lvl-6 Enchant, about 1,111 enchants) to Lvl-1 Enchant, and the level 21 band applies the Alchemist's Playground figures (16 casts a minute, 2 XP a coin, 30 coins) to Low Level Alchemy; the pages state neither figure outright; the level 7 band (41,700) is the Enchanting Chamber page's 55,125 for Lvl-1 Enchant by hand, scaled by the same casual-to-attentive ratio (130,000 to 171,990), and sits between that figure and the page's 27,000 for autocasting

Low Level Alchemy, Superheat Item, High Level Alchemy, Cure Me on araxytes: each is 85% of the stated maximum (60,000, 97,000, 78,000, 414,000) under the up-to rule, not a measured ordinary rate; Tan Leather (110,000) is 85% of the 130,000 its page and the guide give for good timing

Blood bursting desert bandits and Barraging Wilderness bandits: 85% of the guide's 'can reach' figures (150,000 and 230,000; 220,000 idle), which no second source gives; the Wilderness bandits are only rated for Ice Barrage at 94, with no figure for Ice Burst from 70; the guide's 330,000 for stacking Wilderness bandits is more than nine 150 HP bandits on their respawn can give and is not used

Bursting maniacal monkeys: the bands are the strategy page's measured table for auto retaliate at ordinary gear (221,000 at a max hit of 25, about 298,000 barraging at 34); the guide's 250,000 and 320,000 need max hits of 29 and 37; Monkey Madness II only has to be started, which req cannot say, so req asks for the whole quest and is stricter than the game

Burst or barrage Slayer tasks: no wiki page gives a Magic XP rate (xph 0); a third-party guide quotes 200,000 to 320,000 an hour for barraging dust devils, nechryaels and smoke devils in best gear at 94

Crab entries: worked out in shared/domain/rates.ts from the wiki's accuracy and damage formulas (rewritten 12 October 2026): an elemental staff (+10 Magic attack), no damage gear, no potion or prayer, each tier's spells sharing the max hit of the best one unlocked; rock and frost crabs lose a tenth of the hour to resetting aggression; the Gemstone Crab's 12.5% is taken off the cast XP as well as the damage XP, which no page confirms; rock crabs and the Gemstone Crab cast the best spell of any element (on rock crabs earth keeps its 20%); frost crabs cast fire alone, which is the best there but for levels 29 to 34, where Earth Bolt would give 12% more than Fire Strike; the rock crab entry was named 'Rock crabs with earth spells' until 12 October 2026; both it and the Gemstone Crab entry open at 9, though the code rates them from Wind Strike at level 1
Splashing: Earth Surge is 48.2 XP on its own page and 48.5 in the splashing guide's table; the band at 90 uses 48.2

Quest skip to level 34: the Ironman Guide's route (The Grand Tree, Watchtower, The Giant Dwarf) totals 20,100 XP, 124 short of level 34; Watchtower needs 14 Magic on its own page and 15 in the quest rewards table

Not included: Camelot Teleport (about 80,000 from 45), tele-alching (up to 144,600 from 55), stun-alching (184,000 from 80), Spin Flax, Superglass Make, Bake Pie (carried in Cooking), zombie pirates (no rate), Kraken (task only)

Burst and barrage entries on auto retaliate (desert bandits, maniacal monkeys, Wilderness bandits) need a weapon that autocasts Ancient Magicks, and Kruk's Dungeon a light source; both are items, which req cannot state, so the notes carry them
